atoms.b: In order to ((++survive die)) in their habitats, all living things have special characteristics.
These special characteristics have developed over time to suit their ((++environment attitude)) and are called adaptations.

instruction.text: What characteristics of this eagle are adaptations?

feedback.end: Characteristics that help eagles to survive in their environment are adaptations. The colour of the eagle’s eyes does not affect its survival, which is why it’s not an adaptation.

instruction.text: Match the adaptation to how it helps the eagle survive.

feedback.finish: Living things that have the best adaptations survive and have offspring. The offspring inherit these adaptations and continue to pass them down through generations.

atoms.a: Living things that have the best adaptations are more likely to survive.

feedback.finish: In the past, not all giraffes were tall or had long necks. They developed these adaptations over time.

instruction.text: Which two adaptations help giraffes to reach leaves in trees?

feedback.end: Short giraffes had to compete for food with other animals, but taller giraffes could reach the leaves on the tallest trees. They were more likely to survive and passed their adaptations on to their offspring until eventually all giraffes had long necks and legs.

instruction.text: Adaptations can also have disadvantages. How do you think long necks could disadvantage giraffes?

text: As giraffes have very long necks, they must bend down to drink water. This puts them in an awkward position that leaves them vulnerable to attacks from predators.

b.sound: they make giraffes vulnerable to predators

instruction.text: Arctic foxes also had to adapt to their environment. What is their environment like?

feedback.end: Arctic foxes now have thick fur and small bodies that conserve heat to keep them warm. However, they were not always so well adapted to their environment...

atoms.b: In the ((++past future)), arctic foxes had short fur and were not adapted to living in the cold.
This meant that when their habitat got ((++colder brighter)), most of the foxes could not stay warm and died. Some foxes had thicker fur, which allowed them to stay warm and ((++survive die)).
These foxes had offspring who ((++inherited bought)) thick fur. Over time, all arctic foxes inherited thick fur and became well-adapted to their environment.
